configuration.description: Displays Draft Appointments the current user owns.
configuration.fetchxml: <fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="true" savedqueryid="116ae565-8b51-4bdf-a51b-76a3b7cec9d6"><entity name="appointment"><attribute name="subject" /><attribute name="scheduledstart" /><attribute name="scheduledend" /><attribute name="regardingobjectid" /><attribute name="prioritycode" /><attribute name="activityid" /><attribute name="instancetypecode" /><attribute name="location" /><order attribute="scheduledstart" descending="false" /><filter type="and"><condition attribute="statecode" operator="in"><value>0</value><value>3</value></condition><condition attribute="isdraft" operator="eq" value="1" /></filter><link-entity name="activityparty" from="activityid" to="activityid" alias="aa"><filter type="and"><condition attribute="partyid" operator="eq-userid" /><condition attribute="participationtypemask" operator="in"><value>7</value><value>9</value><value>5</value><value>6</value></condition></filter></link-entity></entity></fetch>

layoutxml.xmlWithLogicalObject: <grid name="resultset" object="logical:appointment" jump="subject" select="1" preview="1" icon="1"><row name="result" id="activityid"><cell name="subject" width="250" /><cell name="regardingobjectid" width="100" /><cell name="location" width="100" /><cell name="prioritycode" width="100" /><cell name="scheduledstart" width="100" /><cell name="scheduledend" width="100" /><cell name="instancetypecode" width="100" ishidden="1" /></row></grid>

configuration.name: My Draft Appointments
configuration.offlinesqlquery: /*SelectStart*/select   DISTINCT  "appointment0".[subject] as "subject" , "appointment0".[scheduledstart] as "scheduledstart" , "appointment0".[scheduledend] as "scheduledend" , "appointment0".[regardingobjectid!id] as "regardingobjectid!id" , "appointment0".[regardingobjectid!logicalname] as "regardingobjectid!logicalname" , "appointment0".[regardingobjectid!name] as "regardingobjectid!name" , "appointment0".[prioritycode] as "prioritycode" , "appointment0".[activityid] as "activityid" , "appointment0".[instancetypecode] as "instancetypecode" , "appointment0".[location] as "location"/*SelectEnd*/  /*FromStart*/from  Appointment as "appointment0" 	/*JoinStart*/ join ActivityParty as "aa" on ("appointment0".[activityid]  =  "aa".[activityid!id] and ("aa".[partyid!id] = "!eq-userid!" and ("aa".[participationtypemask] in (7 , 9 , 5 , 6))))/*JoinEnd*//*FromEnd*/  /*WhereStart*/where  (("appointment0".[statecode] in (0 , 3)) and "appointment0".[isdraft] = 1)/*WhereEnd*/  /*OrderByStart*/order by  "appointment0".[scheduledstart] asc/*OrderByEnd*/
